Name: Arieh, Officer of Pekahiah
Summary: Arieh was with Pekahiah in the palace at Samaria when Pekah conspired and smote the king; he is named among those slain with him.
RelatedPeople: Pekahiah, King of Israel; Pekah, King of Israel; Argob, Officer of Pekahiah
LifeLesson: Courtiers fall with the courts they serve.
